note: Everything you can build. size is tiles (w x h). cost is resources consumed when the outline is placed. buildTime is builder-seconds of work. powerUse/powerGen are in kW. supplyRadius (tiles) is how far a pole/substation/generator carries the grid. vision is sight radius, scanRadius is how far a scanner reveals hidden nodes. requiresNode lists the resource kinds the footprint must sit on. variantOf + planetRequirement mark a planet-themed structure that only unlocks where that element exists.

structures.name: Landing Pod
structures.desc: The pod you came down in: headquarters, first store, first power, and the drone hub every machine within 34 tiles hands its output to. Lose it and the run is over.

structures.name: Builder Yard
structures.desc: Houses two builders. More yards means outlines get finished in parallel instead of one at a time.

structures.name: Dormitory
structures.desc: Beds for six. Crew capacity caps how many builders, scouts and guards you can field at once.

structures.name: Medbay
structures.desc: Hurt crew walk here and get patched up instead of dying in the dirt.

structures.name: Workshop
structures.desc: Tools and spares. Builders working within its reach put up outlines a quarter faster.

structures.name: Garage
structures.desc: Parks and repairs four vehicles. Trucks that start a route here come out fully fuelled.

structures.name: Rock Drill I
structures.desc: Bites into an ore patch and coughs up half a unit a second. Slow, cheap, and the first thing you place.

structures.name: Rock Drill II
structures.desc: Twice the bite for twice the power. Also chews a patch out twice as fast, so plan the next one.

structures.name: Rock Drill III
structures.desc: A drill head that does not care what the rock is made of. Hungry for power.

structures.name: Open Quarry
structures.desc: Does not need a node - it just eats the ground. Endless stone and sand, nothing else.

structures.name: Deep Bore
structures.desc: Drills past the patch into the seam under it. Slower than a mk3 but the node never runs out.

structures.name: Fluid Pump
structures.desc: Sinks a pipe into a vent or a pool. Whatever comes up needs a tanker to move it.

structures.name: Gas Extractor
structures.desc: Caps a seep and holds the pressure. Only a gas hauler can take it away.

structures.name: Ice Harvester
structures.desc: Chips a glacier into blocks. On a frozen world this is where all your water comes from.

structures.name: Atmospheric Condenser
structures.desc: Pulls gases straight out of the air. No node needed - the whole sky is the node.

structures.name: Geothermal Tap
structures.desc: Sinks a lined shaft into a magma fissure. Feeds a geothermal plant, or a plasma refinery.

structures.name: Biomass Harvester
structures.desc: Cuts growth inside its reach and lets it grow back. Slower on bare ground, useless on rock.

structures.name: Smelter
structures.desc: A brick box with a fire in it. Turns ore and coal into bars.

structures.name: Arc Furnace
structures.desc: Melts with electricity instead of fire, so it reaches temperatures a smelter cannot. Steel and up.

structures.name: Crusher
structures.desc: Two jaws and a motor. Stone into sand, rubble into salvage.

structures.name: Kiln
structures.desc: Bakes rather than melts. Charcoal from growth, lime from stone, water from ice.

structures.name: Refinery
structures.desc: Boils crude into fractions. Fuel for the trucks, lubricant for the machines.

structures.name: Cracking Tower
structures.desc: Breaks long molecules into short ones under heat and pressure. The road to hydrogen.

structures.name: Chemical Plant
structures.desc: Whatever needs mixing, heating and not exploding. Acid, resin, oxidizer, slurry.

structures.name: Electrolyzer
structures.desc: Shoves current through a fluid until it comes apart. Water becomes rocket fuel this way.

structures.name: Centrifuge
structures.desc: Spins mixtures until the heavy bits separate. Also the only way to enrich uranium.

structures.name: Polymer Press
structures.desc: Squeezes oil into sheet and pellet. Half the modern parts list needs polymer.

structures.name: Glassworks
structures.desc: Sand in, sheet and lenses out. Optics start here.

structures.name: Concrete Mixer
structures.desc: Stone, sand and water into the stuff you pour roads and foundations from.

structures.name: Alloy Foundry
structures.desc: Where the exotic metals get married. Alloy plate and superalloy billets.

structures.name: Assembler I
structures.desc: A bench with arms. Plates, wire, gears, frames and the first two science packs.

structures.name: Assembler II
structures.desc: Faster arms, more recipes. The workhorse of the mid game.

structures.name: Assembler III
structures.desc: Two and a half times a mk1 and it can build satellites. Power bill to match.

structures.name: Circuit Printer
structures.desc: Etches boards properly instead of an assembler's hand-soldering. Much faster per board.

structures.name: Nano Forge
structures.desc: Builds things atom by atom. Four times the speed of a mk1 and it never needs a second pass.

structures.name: Fuel Plant
structures.desc: Ferments growth into fuel and chills hydrogen into the stuff that actually lifts a rocket.

structures.name: Solar Array
structures.desc: Free power while the sun is up, nothing at night. Pair it with batteries or you brown out every evening.

structures.name: Wind Turbine
structures.desc: Cheap and honest, but it only gives what the weather gives. Storms actually help.

structures.name: Combustion Generator
structures.desc: Burns whatever you feed it. Reliable, loud, and the smoke is what brings the swarms.

structures.name: Gas Turbine
structures.desc: Burns gas cleanly and hard. Twice the output of a combustion generator for less noise.

structures.name: Geothermal Plant
structures.desc: Takes magma from a tap and turns the heat into steady power that never cares about the weather.

structures.name: Fission Reactor
structures.desc: One rod runs it for over three minutes. Needs constant water or it cooks itself and everything nearby.

structures.name: Battery Bank
structures.desc: Stores 6000 kJ. Charges when you have spare power and carries the base through the night.

structures.name: Substation
structures.desc: Carries the grid fifteen tiles instead of seven. Two of these replace a line of poles.

structures.name: Power Pole
structures.desc: Nine tiles of grid for almost nothing. Chain them to reach an outlying drill.

structures.name: Storage Crate
structures.desc: Twelve hundred units of anything solid. Every machine whose store network it joins can draw from it without a truck.

structures.name: Warehouse
structures.desc: The hub every truck route wants to end at. Big reach, big shelf.

structures.name: Bulk Silo
structures.desc: Only takes bulk - ore, stone, sand, coal, ice - but takes a lot of it, cheaply.

structures.name: Fluid Tank
structures.desc: Liquids only. Rupturing one in a raid makes a mess that catches fire.

structures.name: Pressure Tank
structures.desc: Holds pressurised gas. Do not put it next to the flame turrets.

structures.name: Haulage Depot
structures.desc: Takes anything and reaches ten tiles. Six route slots, so it is the natural centre of an outpost.

structures.name: Loading Dock
structures.desc: Attach it to a store and trucks load three times faster. Cheapest throughput upgrade there is.

structures.name: Dirt Path
structures.desc: Trodden ground. A quarter faster than raw terrain and it costs one stone.

structures.name: Gravel Road
structures.desc: Levelled and packed. Seventy per cent faster, and mud stops mattering.

structures.name: Paved Road
structures.desc: Poured slab. Trucks run at better than double cross-country speed on it.

structures.name: Bridge Span
structures.desc: The only way a wheeled vehicle crosses water. Costs more than road per tile, obviously.

structures.name: Truck Garage
structures.desc: Builds and keeps ground haulers. You need one before you can run any route.

structures.name: Tanker Bay
structures.desc: Same idea for tankers and gas haulers. Liquids will not ride in a crate truck.

structures.name: Drone Pad
structures.desc: Drones ignore terrain entirely - no roads, no water, no cliffs - but they carry very little.

structures.name: Hover Lane
structures.desc: A powered strip that lifts a hover truck off the ground. Three times cross-country speed, and it draws power every tile.

structures.name: Timber Barricade
structures.desc: Stops a swarmer for a few seconds. That is often exactly long enough.

structures.name: Steel Wall
structures.desc: Four times the wooden wall and it does not burn.

structures.name: Reinforced Wall
structures.desc: Concrete over steel, with armour that shrugs off small bites entirely.

structures.name: Gate
structures.desc: Opens for your own trucks and builders, stays shut for everything else.

structures.name: Watchtower
structures.desc: Mostly eyes, a little rifle fire. Sees twice as far as anything else this cheap, and it is the only gun you have until steel.

structures.name: Gun Turret
structures.desc: The default answer. Good against anything that comes in a straight line.

structures.name: Flame Turret
structures.desc: Short reach, huge damage, and it hits the whole crowd. Made for chokepoints.

structures.name: Laser Turret
structures.desc: No ammunition ever, but it eats power and goes quiet the moment the grid browns out.

structures.name: Tesla Coil
structures.desc: Arcs to four targets at once. Against a swarm it out-damages anything else its size.

structures.name: Artillery Piece
structures.desc: Shells nests before they hatch a wave. Cannot hit anything standing on top of it.

structures.name: Missile Battery
structures.desc: The only ground gun that reliably hits flyers. Expensive per shot, worth it.

structures.name: Slow-Field Emitter
structures.desc: Everything hostile inside the field moves at just over half speed. Multiplies every turret you own.

structures.name: Mine Field
structures.desc: One big bang, then it is gone. Cheap enough to carpet an approach.

structures.name: Shield Generator
structures.desc: A bubble that soaks damage for everything under it and refills between waves. Dies fast if the grid does.

structures.name: Repair Bay
structures.desc: Patches walls and turrets inside its reach between waves, using iron plate from the nearest store.

structures.name: Short Radar
structures.desc: Sees twenty-four tiles and slowly sweeps twenty-six for buried nodes. The first thing that makes the map stop being dark.

structures.name: Long Radar
structures.desc: Covers most of a local map from one mast. Also spots waves forming at the edge.

structures.name: Scanner Tower
structures.desc: Does not see the ground, only what is under it. Reveals resource nodes fast and cheap.

structures.name: Survey Station
structures.desc: Reads the region map instead of the local one: tells you which neighbouring tiles are worth landing a second outpost on.

structures.name: Satellite Uplink
structures.desc: Talks to anything you have in orbit. Without one, a launched satellite is just an expensive rock.

structures.name: Probe Launcher
structures.desc: Throws a probe at another planet. When it arrives you learn what that world is made of before you commit a rocket.

structures.name: Frontier Beacon
structures.desc: Lights a claim that can be seen from orbit. Light one on enough worlds and you have won.

structures.name: Laboratory
structures.desc: Eats science packs and turns them into research. Build more to research faster - they stack directly.

structures.name: Research Station
structures.desc: Three labs' worth in one footprint, and it can hold the higher packs.

structures.name: Observatory
structures.desc: Watches the sky. Reveals the rough make-up of nearby planets without spending a probe, and helps research.

structures.name: Archive
structures.desc: Everything researched here survives the journey. Without one, a new planet starts you back at basic tools.

structures.name: Launch Pad
structures.desc: A poured slab with a flame trench and a hold. Everything you want to take to the next world is loaded here.

structures.name: Rocket Assembly
structures.desc: The gantry that builds sections, satellites and probes. The single most expensive machine on the planet.

structures.name: Satellite Launcher
structures.desc: A small rail for small payloads. Cheaper than using the main pad every time you want eyes in orbit.

structures.name: Orbital Lift
structures.desc: Once it stands, cargo goes up without a rocket. It is what makes an orbital station affordable.

structures.name: Landing Beacon
structures.desc: Marks a safe drop point. A rocket arriving at a planet with one of these lands right on your base instead of wherever it likes.

structures.name: Cryo Forge
structures.desc: Quenching steel in cryonite gives alloy plate for a third of the titanium. Only works on a world cold enough to keep cryonite stable.

structures.name: Plasma Refinery
structures.desc: A pyrocrystal core holds an arc hotter than any furnace. Smelts at better than twice the speed and skips the ingot step for steel.

structures.name: Void Condenser
structures.desc: Umbral shale pulls thin gas out of nothing. The only practical source of helium-3 on a world without a gas giant overhead.

structures.name: Resonance Mill
structures.desc: Aetherite hums at exactly the right frequency to lay circuit traces without etching. Four logic cores a pass.

structures.name: Bio Vat
structures.desc: Grows plate instead of rolling it, and the vat heals its own damage. Needs a world where xenoplasm still lives.

structures.name: Umbral Kiln
structures.desc: Bakes shale into shielding that eats heat and hides what is under it. Cheap heat shields, and enemy scouts walk past your base.

structures.name: Glimmer Still
structures.desc: Distils glimmer salt into lenses three at a time. On a glimmer world, lasers and long optics stop being a bottleneck.

structures.name: Ferrovine Loom
structures.desc: Ferrovine grows metal as cable, so the loom just has to spool it. Ten wire from two vine, no copper at all.

structures.name: Voltaic Coil Works
structures.desc: Voltaic ore holds a charge before you even connect it. Six battery cells a pass instead of two.

structures.name: Storm Tap
structures.desc: Draws charge out of the air, and out of a storm two and a half times harder. On a storm world this is your base load.

structures.name: Helion Still
structures.desc: Cracks helion gas straight into rocket fuel and runs a fusion tap off the waste, so it pays its own power bill and then some. Only on a world that vents helion.

structures.name: Null Forge
structures.desc: Inside a nullstone shell every field goes flat, so superalloy can be cold-worked with no platinum in the mix at all. Half again the speed of an alloy foundry.

structures.name: Emberlace Loom
structures.desc: Weaves emberlace threads into heat shielding three at a time, for a third of what an assembler spends on one. Twice the speed of the assembler it replaces.

structures.name: Pearl Press
structures.desc: Bunks for fourteen and a press that grinds brinepearl into a tonic the labs will take instead of acid glassware. A dormitory houses six; this one houses a shift.
